dir.description: Adapter directory at the repo root (e.g. '.claude').

commands.description: Command wrapper surface, or null when the harness has no project-scoped command support.

dir.description: Directory generate-wrappers.js writes one wrapper per commands/*.md into.

style.description: 'claude': frontmatter description + resolution line (also used by Codex and Cursor). 'opencode': adapter-behavior wrapper plus a JSON command registry.

registry.description: For style 'opencode': the JSON config file that carries the command registry (generate-wrappers.js owns the whole file).

hooks.description: Whether sync:hook-wiring emits executable hook wiring for this harness (builders live in scripts/lib/hook-wiring.js).

mcp.description: Project-scoped MCP config location, or null when the harness only reads a home-level config.

format.description: 'universal': the de-facto-standard mcpServers shape, written by sync:mcp. 'toml': a config.toml with [mcp_servers.*] sections (Grok Build), written by sync:mcp. 'opencode': mcp block embedded in the command registry, written by sync:wrappers. 'kilo': a kilo.json with a top-level mcp object (Kilo), written by sync:mcp.

entryPoints.description: Paths doctor.js asserts exist for the adapter to count as installed.
